quarterly_data.quarter: Merck & Co. press release: Ifinatamab Deruxtecan Biologics License Application for (09-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Daiichi Sankyo and Merck voluntarily withdrew the U.S. BLA seeking accelerated approval of ifinatamab deruxtecan (I-DXd) for extensive-stage small cell lung cancer progressing on or after platinum-based chemotherapy, after FDA discussions concluded the supporting data, including the IDeate-Lung01 Phase 2 trial, do not meet the requirements for accelerated approval. Enrollment in the Phase 3 IDeate-Lung02 trial continues (Daiichi Sankyo: near completion), and two other Phase 3 trials (IDeate-Prostate01, IDeate-Esophageal01) are underway. Merck oncology head Marjorie Green: disappointed the current dataset does not support approval at this time.
